---
title: "One workspace, two paper paths"
---

This demo has a workspace [bibliography](references.bib) and two writing paths:

1. [Literature review](lit-review/index.qmd): edit the Quarto source, which cites the workspace bibliography. Quarto can also render it to PDF or LaTeX on demand (see the [workspace guide](https://github.com/allenai/asta-plugins/blob/main/plugins/asta-tools/skills/workspace/assets/DEVELOPER.md#getting-a-latex-pdf)).
2. [Separate paper](paper/main.tex): edit LaTeX directly. The paper is paired with an Overleaf project, which you can [view in Overleaf](https://www.overleaf.com/project/6ad3a5f38f722e2e09c9a8f9/share#a44d86bf6428da0098e082455586b759b61d54f5764c735f): co-authors can edit it there, and the workspace reviews their changes in pull requests. Overleaf sees only the `paper` directory, so the paper keeps its own [bibliography](paper/references.bib), with entries copied from the workspace's.

On a pull request, the preview builds a PDF of the separate paper. [The saved diff demo](demo/index.qmd) shows edits to the paper and the Quarto literature review. New files appear as “added” in What changed; edits to existing files show a diff.
